source.stem:
Lithium reacts with fluorine to form the compound lithium fluoride.

Which statement about this reaction is correct?

options.text: Each fluorine atom gains one electron.
Each fluorine atom gains two or more electrons.
Each fluorine atom loses one electron.
Each fluorine atom loses two or more electrons.

intelligence.enrichment: Mass is measured with a balance, which must be brought to zero by tare or reset when needed; liquid volume is measured with a measuring cylinder, whose capacity and smallest division set what it can read. Zeroing the balance and reading the measuring cylinder correctly produce usable mass and volume measurements for later density calculations. The displayed balance number and any meniscus mark can be read directly because the instrument already gives the measurement.
